captions.detailed: An open timber belfry structure crafted from dark brown wood, featuring four round vertical support posts. A slatted square floor platform is mounted near the bottom, while a gabled saddle roof covers the top. A golden-brown bell hangs from a central horizontal crossbeam via a revolute joint, allowing it to swing freely back and forth.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a timber belfry with four support posts, a slatted platform, a gabled saddle roof, and a central swinging bell. The bell should be mounted to a horizontal crossbeam with a revolute joint to enable rotational swinging.
captions.factory: The belfry is constructed by first creating a base frame using cylinder primitives for the four vertical posts, combined with box primitives for the slatted floor platform and crossbeams. A gabled roof is modeled using thin angled boxes. The bell is constructed using a revolved profile or tapered cylinder for the main body, joined to a small mounting loop. A revolute joint is then defined along the horizontal axis of the crossbeam to connect the swinging bell to the fixed belfry structure.
